unease.definition: a feeling of worry or discomfort

usable.definition: able to be used successfully or effectively

untrustworthy.definition: not reliable or likely to tell the truth

unclear.definition: not easy to understand; not certain

uproar.definition: a loud and sudden disturbance, often with strong emotional reaction
